note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: the unit moved verbatim to core, with only the family identifiers renamed. RFC 8956 Section 3.6: "0: MUST be set to 0 on NLRI encoding". One shared component carrying DF|IsF, FF and LF must encode IPv6 and IPv6-VPN as 2, 4, 8 (DF, reserved in Figure 1, cleared), while IPv4 and IPv4-VPN keep 3. Core fragmentMask(AFIIPv6)=0x0e is what clears it. The high reserved bits are covered by the 3.6-1 unit.
